text: Right now, somewhere on Earth, someone is opening a Coca-Cola. And someone else. And someone else. Every single day, people drink about two point two billion servings of the company's drinks.
It started in 1886 with a man selling about nine glasses a day... in a pharmacy.

Along the way, its owners sold one of the most valuable ideas in the company's history for one dollar, changed the recipe and got yelled at by an entire country, and shipped whole bottling plants to a world war.
So how did a drink that sold nine glasses a day take over the planet? It starts with a wounded soldier and a jug of syrup.
